rule: The office-hours skill requires vetting an 'is it worth adding X?' ask with the forcing questions (premise, status quo, narrowest wedge) before proposing or writing an implementation plan.
prompt: We should add a Redis-backed cache layer to this CLI tool so repeated runs are faster. Is it worth building? How would you approach it?
expect: restates or challenges the premise of the ask before answering
names the status quo or existing alternative and what is genuinely missing
proposes a narrowest first version and names what is explicitly out of scope
expect_not: jumps straight into implementation steps or code without questioning whether the capability is warranted
